Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.loot

Enum Class BucketLootTables.Reward

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BucketLootTables.Reward>
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.loot.BucketLootTables.Reward

Enclosing class:
BucketLootTables
public static enum BucketLootTables.Reward extends Enum<BucketLootTables.Reward>
One independent structure-loot roll. The shipped manifest supplies each value's item, probability, optional powder-snow content, and complete target-table set.
